title: Nahm Poles and 0-Instantons
summary: We study self-dual 0-connections, or 0-instantons, on asymptotically hyperbolic 4-manifolds. These connections develop a uniform singularity along the conformal infinity, and are asymptotic, at each point of the boundary, to a "Nahm pole" model solution on $H^4$. Examples include the Levi-Civita spin connections on $S^+$ over spin Poincaré-Einstein 4-manifolds. Inspired by the Fefferman-Graham expansion for Poincaré-Einstein metrics, we study the asymptotic expansion of these 0-instantons.
